The 2023 measured-current-state figure 23 independently names the same five halls and records the current renamings used by the model. Page 33 identifies figure 29 as the pepiano or first box tier, while page 35 states that its central axial bay is an entrance and locates the imperial loggia on the two tiers above; the Royal Box guide stop is therefore left unbound without an upper-tier plan.
